name: Joe Jackson (style) — D 126
description: Modelled on the sound of Joe Jackson — original parts, not any of his songs: a bright piano driving latin-pop with montuno chords, congas, cowbell, clave and timbales, a syncopated finger bass, vibes and alto-sax melody, brass pushes, and a new-wave rock break with overdriven guitar. D major at 126 bpm, D Bm G A. Rows 1-7 drums and percussion (ch 10), 8-B bass SUBROUTINES and C-E bass rows (ch 13), F-I piano SUBROUTINES and J-L piano rows (ch 15), M-O melody (ch 11), P horns (ch 16), Q guitar (ch 14), R-W sections, X jam. Row 0 plays the song.
prompt: build a new bank modelled after the band The Cure and make one modelled after the band Depeche Mode and make one modelled after Joe Jackson
